intelligent-planning.title: Intelligent planning and alerts
intelligent-planning.intro: Ask a configured model to suggest schedules for existing tasks. Review its basis and explicitly apply any changes.
intelligent-planning.goal_limit: The goal is too long. Shorten it before starting the analysis.
intelligent-planning.no_planner: No eligible planner is present in the loaded tools. Enable a Suma read-only planning profile, then refresh its real observation.
intelligent-planning.not_health: Configuration is available. Model account health is confirmed only by a real call.
intelligent-planning.task_scope: Choose existing tasks from the loaded planning view. The server freezes their current context before analysis.
intelligent-planning.no_tasks: Load existing project tasks before requesting an analysis.
intelligent-planning.selection_changed: Some selected tasks are no longer in this view. Clear and select the current tasks again.
intelligent-planning.model_ack: I agree to send the selected task, requirement and capacity context to the execution node's configured model.
intelligent-planning.no_analyses: No analysis records have been returned.
intelligent-planning.basis_changed: The frozen basis no longer matches current project data. Applying is blocked; create a new analysis after review.
intelligent-planning.original_unavailabl: Original model text is not available in this response. Its recorded fingerprint is shown below.
intelligent-planning.invalid_json: Use the agreed schedule format and only tasks from the frozen analysis. The server checks dates, estimates and current versions again.
intelligent-planning.save_first: This JSON differs from the saved proposal. Save its revision before applying.
intelligent-planning.version_changed: The analysis version changed. Read the latest version before continuing with this draft.
intelligent-planning.decision_reason: Reason for revision or dismissal (optional when applying)
intelligent-planning.apply_ack: I have reviewed the saved proposal and agree to update the selected schedules. This does not transfer task responsibility or approve delivery.
intelligent-planning.apply_default_reaso: I approve applying the reviewed schedule changes.
intelligent-planning.risk_boundary: These are model risk suggestions, not confirmed incidents. Reviewing or closing an alert does not change task status or send external messages.
intelligent-planning.no_alerts: No alerts in the returned status range.
intelligent-planning.original_operation: An original operation still needs confirmation
intelligent-planning.analysis_saved: Analysis operation confirmed. Its recorded state and actual run are shown below.
intelligent-planning.invalid_read: The planning response is incomplete or belongs to a different project. Refresh before continuing.
intelligent-planning.refresh_failed: The operation was confirmed, but the latest view could not be loaded. Refresh without repeating the operation.
intelligent-planning.access_changed: Current access changed. Previous analysis and alert contents have been cleared.
intelligent-planning.reason.invalid_outp: The model planning output does not satisfy the fixed proposal contract
intelligent-planning.reason.source_chang: Planning source has changed; create a new analysis
intelligent-planning.reason.profile_inva: Select a current enabled read-only Suma planning profile
intelligent-planning.reason.prompt_limit: Planning context exceeds 32000 UTF-8 bytes; select a smaller task scope
intelligent-planning.reason.version_conf: The planning analysis has changed; reload before deciding
intelligent-planning.reason.model_confir: Confirm that the selected task content will be sent to the configured model
intelligent-planning.reason.apply_confir: Confirm the proposed schedule changes before applying them
intelligent-planning.reason.execution_fa: The planning execution did not complete successfully
intelligent-planning.reason.execution_un: The planning execution outcome is unknown; inspect the original run
intelligent-planning.reason.source_unaut: The planning creator no longer has current execution authority
intelligent-planning.reason.alert_invali: Invalid planning alert decision or version
